name: AnymeX+ β (Beta)
subtitle: AnymeX+ beta builds
description: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.

apps.name: AnymeX+ β
apps.subtitle: AnymeX+ beta builds
apps.localizedDescription: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.
apps.versionDescription:
Beta v1.1.4-beta+1

- Test: fix escapes
- TV (Flutter): logins from your phone, working library button
  - Phone/PC: Settings → TV Remote → Send logins to the Flutter TV app. Type the 6-digit code the TV shows (Settings → Accounts → Get logins from your phone). One-time P-256 keys + the code make the lock key, so the network only sees locked bytes and a wrong code gets a new code.
  - Sends AniList, Simkl, MyAnimeList and Stremio (access tokens only). Both sides keep the key; the phone sends fresh logins to paired TVs each time it starts (Simkl renews weekly).
  - TV Settings → Accounts shows Simkl and MyAnimeList too.
  - Details: 'Add to library' reads your Stremio library ('In library ✓'), and adds or removes for real.
- TV (Flutter): open shows where you are, calmer picture loading, no double Continue Watching
  - Details open on the season and episode you're at (and after playing).
  - Pictures load into one plain dark box and fade in, instead of coloured blocks; start-up keeps the splash until Home's first screen has its pictures (9 s at most).
  - Continue Watching drops doubles: the same show from AniList and Stremio, or as two Stremio entries (Kitsu and IMDb). Kitsu episodes read 'E1', not 'S8147 E1'.
- TV (Flutter) player: no dark bands at the top and bottom
- TV (Flutter): audio tracks, resume from Stremio's latest, watched episodes
  - LG's video plugin copied to packages/video_player_webos with two more calls: the track list (sourceInfo) and NDL_MediaSelectTrack. The player gets an Audio button; the language is remembered.
  - The resume point is read fresh from Stremio's library (it used the TV's older copy, minutes behind the phone).
  - Series show which episodes are watched (Stremio's watched list) and the episode you're on, refreshed after playing.
- TV (Flutter) CI: look at LG's SDK for audio tracks and the Back key
- TV (Flutter): fix a name clash
- TV (Flutter): the player, sources and Stremio sign-in
- TV (Flutter): Left at the edge goes back; rows stay under the banner
  - LG's Flutter SDK doesn't pass the remote's Back button to apps yet (lg-flutter-webos/flutter-webos#12; LG plans it for around the end of the year), so Left at the left edge goes back: it closes a page opened on top, or opens the menu. Noted in Settings → About this TV.
  - Left only moves along the same line: on the first card it no longer climbs to rows above that are scrolled along.
  - Home's rows are clipped below the banner, so a row scrolled up no longer draws over the highlighted card's info.
- TV (Flutter): steadier rows, search box, pointer, key log
  - Rows scroll themselves: the highlighted card sits at the left edge and the page brings the whole row into view (no more two scrolls fighting). Cards near the highlighted one and the rows around it are kept built, so moving, wrapping and Up/Down always find their card.
  - The Magic Remote pointer no longer takes the highlight right after arrow presses or on tiny hand movements (it dragged the highlight to random cards).
  - If the highlight ever lands on nothing, it goes back onto the page.
  - Search: the box is highlighted like a button; OK types (keyboard), and closing the keyboard, Back, Up or Down return to the box. Movies and series are searched separately (more and better matches).
  - Settings → About this TV keeps the last remote keys and what Back did across restarts.
- TV (Flutter): row wrap, search and Back fixes
  - Rows: the highlighted card stays alive while its row scrolls, so wrapping from the last card to the first (or jumping far) no longer loses the highlight, stalls, or sends the next arrow press somewhere random.
  - Search: Left at the start of the box (or an empty box) goes to the menu; Movies & TV results no longer wait for an IMDb lookup per title (a failed lookup dropped them), the id is looked up when you open one.
  - Back: one press is one step even if the TV sends it twice; from a page it opens the menu first.
- TV (Flutter): menu and rows move the way a TV app does
  - Menu: Up / Down move along it, Right goes back into the page; it no longer drops into the page behind it. A pointer resting where the menu opens doesn't grab the highlight (only a real pointer move does).
  - Rows: Left / Right go card by card and wrap from the last card to the first; Left on the first card opens the menu. Up / Down go to the next row at the card that row last had (no more landing on another card).
  - Left in a page goes to the item on the left, or the menu when there is none. Choosing a tab goes into it.
- TV (Flutter): the TV layout
- TV Flutter check: rhttp needs reqwest_unstable for http3
- TV Flutter check: main() without arguments; no LDFLAGS in the C compiler
- TV Flutter check: NDK compiler on PATH; only LG plugins that fit
- TV Flutter check: TV libraries (Isar, rhttp), LG plugins, app id, publish for Homebrew
  - lib/plus/webos.dart: knows when it runs on the TV; Isar's core from the app's lib folder; rhttp can be told where its library is.
  - main.dart: no protocol handlers or window manager on the TV.
- TV Flutter check: show where Isar's native part comes from
- TV Flutter check: hold packages to the app's versions (same major)
- TV Flutter check: relax versions for flutter-webOS's Dart 3.10
- TV: Flutter feasibility build of the whole app for webOS (logs only)
